description: A data/features/<id>.yaml file: feature types a map can place (spec 26, Phase 1 contract).

footprint.description: [width, height] in cells at rot 0; odd rot swaps them.

blocks.description: all = nothing walks through; vehicles = infantry may pass (sim treats it as all until a later phase); none = decoration.

lanes.description: Bridges only: deck width in cells (spec 26 section 17).

walkable.description: Spec 32: units walk on it over deep water, like a bridge deck (piers).

hardGround.description: Spec 35 §5b: ground materials (names of layerNames.ground) the feature cannot be dug on; any road refuses too.

wheelsBlockedState.description: Spec 35 §5b: wheeled hulls cannot cross the feature while its damage state is at most this (0 finished, 1 half, 2 just started). Omitted: never stops them.

repairPct.description: Spec 35: repair or dig speed of the type, percent of the base rate (default 100).

hp.description: Spec 31: hit points. 0 (default) means the feature cannot be damaged.

states.description: Spec 31: damage state thresholds in percent of hp (defaults 70 and 35, as Zero Hour). Damaged at or below the first, wrecked at or below the second.

destroy.description: Spec 31: what the feature becomes at zero hp. Omitted means it disappears.

collapseTicks.description: Spec 31 block 1: ticks a building at zero hp stays standing (wrecked) before it becomes `becomes`. 0 (default) is at once.

crushLevel.description: Spec 31 block 1: lowest crusher level that flattens the feature (tracked hulls are 1). 0 (default) means vehicles cannot crush it. Wheeled vehicles shove and damage the ones with blocks none.

flammable.description: Spec 31 block 1: the feature burns when hit. It loses dps hit points every everyTicks ticks, may light each flammable feature within spreadRadius cells (spreadPermille in 1000 per neighbour per tick, seeded) and burns out after burnTicks.

garrison.description: Spec 31 block 2: infantry can garrison this feature (Zero Hour GarrisonContain). Occupants are hidden, cannot be targeted and fire with the percent bonuses; a neutral building takes its riders' team and reverts when emptied.

evictOnWrecked.description: Occupants leave when the building reaches the wrecked state.

allowNeutral.description: An empty (neutral) building accepts riders (default true).

allowEnemies.description: Riders may join a building held by another player (default false).

render.description: Free-form hints for the client renderer of the family (model id, colours, scale...); the sim ignores it.
